title: xVGAE: A Hierarchical Variational Graph Autoencoder for Exchangeable Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.30815v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graphs play a crucial role in many applications, ranging from drug discovery to social network modeling and astronomy. Generative models for graphs have substantially advanced in recent years, but we identify relatively simple scenarios where state-of-the-art models struggle to converge within a standard compute budget, or exhibit prohibitively slow generation times. We propose a generative architecture that achieves quality competitive with state-of-the-art models and is orders of magnitude faster at generation. Our approach is inspired by the Aldous-Hoover theorem, a classic representation theorem that characterizes any probability distribution of graphs that is invariant to permutations of node indices or exchangeable. This theorem establishes that three ingredients suffice: a graph-level latent variable, a set of exchangeable node-specific latent variables, and a so-called graphon function that maps graph- and node-level variables

translated_title: xVGAE：一种面向可交换图的层次化变分图自编码器
translated_abstract: 图在许多应用中扮演着至关重要的角色，涵盖从药物发现到社交网络建模再到天文学等领域。近年来，图生成模型取得了长足进步，但我们发现，在最先进的模型中，存在一些相对简单的场景，这些模型在标准计算预算内难以收敛，或表现出极其缓慢的生成速度。我们提出了一种生成架构，其生成质量可与最先进的模型相媲美，且生成速度提高了几个数量级。我们的方法受 Aldous-Hoover 定理的启发，这是一个经典的表示定理，它刻画了任何对节点索引置换不变（即可交换）的图的概率分布。该定理表明，三个要素即可满足需求：一个图级潜变量、一组可交换的节点级潜变量，以及一个将图级和节点级变量进行映射的所谓 graphon 函数……
tldr: 本文提出 xVGAE，一种受 Aldous-Hoover 定理启发的层次化变分图自编码器，在生成质量与最先进模型相当的同时，将生成速度提升了几个数量级。
